task_success_rule: native OpenDoorTask predicate_sequence with unchanged YAML threshold
camera_alignment: obs[t] before action[t], next_obs[t] after action[t]

variant_spec.name: glass
variant_spec.semantic_anchor: Original successful pregrasp actually intersects added source geometry. Fixed baseline task, layout, target and control policy; independent paired planning and physical audits required.

pregrasp_validation.checks: cuRobo constraints and independent FCL planning clearances at all dense samples

delivery_gate_note: Collector completion alone is not full acceptance; independent scene, causal, geometry, paired planning and video gates required.

review_gates.notes: Diagnostic motion thresholds do not replace the original strict OpenDoorTask success predicate or source safety margins. Neutral tolerances apply from the first post-reset observation, including startup.

contact_units: Native PhysX get_contact_data(dt=physics_dt): normal forces in N, points/separation in m; signed normals preserved.
recording_start: Immediately after source env.reset; no additional unrecorded settling. Source reset internals are outside the recorded trial.
contact_localization_scope: PhysX finger-to-door body filter plus bounds computed from source collision mesh vertices, not authored USD extents; independent source-shape distance audit required.
